app.name: Tallypress
app.tagline: Monthly sales, margin and cash for your WooCommerce shop

setupNeeded.title: No shop configured
setupNeeded.body: Create the dev shop with `npm run db:seed`, then reload this page.
setupNeeded.openingBody: Tallypress needs your starting bank balance and opening stock before it can show results.

overview.title: Shop overview
overview.roiHelp: Invested = opening stock value + all restocks.
overview.netRemainingHelp: Money in the account, minus the VAT and tax still to pay and the cost of goods sold that has not been bought back yet.
overview.stockValueHelp: The goods still on the shelves, valued at what they cost you (not at the selling price).
overview.investedHelp: Money put into stock: the opening stock plus every restock since. The ROI is measured against it.

simulator.title: What can I spend? (simulation)
simulator.help: Move the percentage to see the effect live. Nothing changes until you save it as the default.
simulator.pct: Share of net earnings kept for personal use
simulator.restockHelp: Money in the account, minus VAT and tax set aside, minus the personal share still to take.

month.heading: Month
month.lateAdjustments: includes late changes to earlier months
month.missingCost: {n} sold line(s) have no purchase cost yet, so profit is overstated. Set it in Stock.
month.loss: Costs exceed the net revenue this month.
month.endDisclaimerIntro: This is an expected balance, not the real balance of your bank account. Tallypress works it out from what it knows: the WooCommerce orders (counted as collected as soon as they are processing or completed) and the movements you record by hand.
month.endDisclaimerListTitle: To be reliable it needs up-to-date manual data. These are not included, or only if you enter them:
endDisclaimerItems: Payments of taxes and contributions (VAT, income tax, social security): here they are only set aside, the real account is debited when you actually pay them.
Extra e-commerce expenses: payment fees (PayPal, cards), shipping costs you bear, platforms and subscriptions, advertising, packaging.
Restocks and withdrawals: every purchase of goods and every personal withdrawal must be recorded.
Real collections: an order is counted even if the payment has not reached the account yet; returns and partial refunds may not be up to date.
month.endDisclaimerOutro: Compare this figure with your bank statement from time to time: a large gap means some movements are missing. Rows marked as estimated (purchases, VAT, taxes) are worked out by Tallypress; replace them with the real movements when you have them.
month.historyNote: Before {date}, the day Tallypress starts tracking the account balance and the stock. Only sales and estimated profit are shown for this month, with no balance.

stock.title: Stock and purchase prices
stock.mismatch: differs from WooCommerce: was a restock not recorded?
stock.restockHelp: Adds the lot, blends it into the average cost, and takes the amount out of the shop account.
stock.manualHelp: For items with no purchase history, such as products without stock tracking.
stock.noItems: No products yet. Sync from WooCommerce in Setup.
stock.formsHint: The forms list the items on this page: search by name to find another one.

ledger.title: Shop account movements
ledger.salesNote: Sales are not listed here: they come from WooCommerce orders.
ledger.movementHelp: Booked today. The amount is always positive: the type decides whether it adds to or takes from the shop account.

form.invalid: Enter an amount greater than zero.
form.noteMissing: Add a description for this type.

setup.openingDone: The starting point is recorded. Currency and starting point can no longer be changed.
setup.openingIntro: Choose the day Tallypress starts counting, the money in the shop account that day, and the stock you had with its purchase price (without VAT). Orders before that day are ignored.
setup.needSync: Sync from WooCommerce first, so the product list is available.
setup.openingWarn: This can be done only once.

range.title: Import a period
range.help: Brings in the orders of a period without erasing anything. If the period starts before your starting date, the starting date moves back and the opening stock is rebuilt for it. Products are not re-read from the shop.
range.rebuild: Recalculate months that are already closed
range.rebuildHelp: Only needed to go back before a closed month: closed months are rebuilt from the data and their snapshots replaced.
range.moved: Starting date moved to {date}; opening stock rebuilt for {lots} items.

errors.invalid: Check the dates: use a valid period that is not in the future.
errors.no_items: Sync the products from the shop first.
errors.gap: The period must reach the existing history: end it at or after your starting date, or leave the end empty.
errors.closed: Some months are already closed. Tick the box to recalculate them, or import a period inside the existing history.
errors.busy: A sync or import is already running. Try again in a moment.

range.historyOnlyHelp: For periods before your starting date: adds the sales without an account balance or opening stock for those months. Nothing else changes.
